    Higher Ext between normalized modules (Lemma 6.3(2)) #

    positive-deformations.tex: "In a minimal graded projective cover of a nonprojective M_i, every summand P⟨a⟩ has a ≥ 1 […] A nonzero component of a kernel inclusion Z⟨b⟩ → P⟨a⟩ is also radical. […] Hence b − a ≥ 1 and b ≥ 2. […] Dimension shifting gives Ext^n(M_i, M_j)_t = Ext^1(Ω^{n−1}M_i, M_j)_t = 0 (t > −2n) […] Projective summands contribute zero."

    Here the cover is P = ⊕_ℓ M_{x_ℓ}⟨d_ℓ⟩ → M_i, ℓ running over homogeneous bases of the spaces C_d(P_x, X_i) (cπ, with graded k-section cs).

    Deviation: this cover need not be minimal. Minimality is used in the paper only to see that kernel summands Z⟨b⟩ have b ≥ 2. Here the bound is proved for the nonprojective summands directly (two_le_shift): every component Z → M_{x_ℓ} has degree b − d_ℓ, and it vanishes when b − d_ℓ ≤ 0, by eq:normalized-hom-degrees, since Z ≠ P_{x_ℓ}. Projective summands contribute zero whatever their shift.
